title: BDC XBRL per-CIK unified wrapper (dispatch + staging + content signatures)

dispatch.description: Identifier classification rules for source reconciliation wrappers

rule_prefix.description: Prefix for generated rule IDs (e.g. TRINITY, SARATOGA)

prefix_rules.description: Map of identifier prefix text to family name (debt/equity/warrant/mixed)

leaf_markers_by_family.description: Per-family list of leaf-level marker strings. Omit to use defaults.

aggregate_markers.description: Strings in identifiers that indicate aggregate/subtotal rows

non_private_markers.description: Strings indicating non-private-market instruments (cash, money market, etc.)

issuer_from_identifier.description: Where the issuer name as built matches when_issuer_re (a label, a rate, a heading), the first pattern whose group 1 matches the member text gives the issuer. For a filer whose member puts the issuer in a moving segment (Stepstone).

industry_from_identifier_re.description: Regex whose group 1 is the filer's industry inside the member text; fills a row with no industry (Goldman Sachs BDC, D-114). Rare captures that map to no GICS label are not taken.

industry_label_gics.description: This filer's own printed industry labels mapped to a GICS sub-industry name, for this fund's rows only (Silver Point 2026-10-19: 'Industrial Products & Services', 'Oilfield Services'). Consulted before the shared alias table; labels compared case-insensitively with spaces collapsed. A target that is not a GICS sub-industry name is refused. Use instead of a shared alias where the label is broad or another fund prints it with another meaning. Evidence required: the printed label on the fund's rows.

lien_from_identifier.description: The filer's own lien abbreviation in the member text, as {lien: regex} ('FLSS' for First Lien Senior Secured, Stepstone 2026-06-30). Fills a blank lien on loan rows only.

not_cash_markers.description: The filer's own column words that hold the bare word 'cash' on a loan row ('Cash IR / PIK Rate'). A row containing one is not taken as cash by the bare-word check; money-market and Treasury markers still apply.

entity_signals_re.description: Regex for entity signals (LLC, Inc, etc.). Omit to use default.

fallback_family_patterns.description: Fallback patterns tried when no prefix_rules entry matches

canonical_strip_re.description: Regex stripped from identifiers before computing keys

no_prefix_is_aggregate.description: When true, identifiers matched via fallback (no prefix text) are classified as aggregate

issuer_name_strip_re.description: Regex removed from the end of this filer's staged issuer name. For a filer that numbers the rows of one borrower in the member name (BCRED 'Riser Merger Sub, Inc. 1' and '... 2'; HPS, North Haven, Monroe the same), so the number is not part of the issuer. The raw identifier keeps it. Evidence required: two numbered members of one borrower beside their printed rows.

issuer_name_strip_to_instrument.description: When true, the text issuer_name_strip_re removes becomes the row's instrument_description where that is blank (or goes in front of it). Monroe, Blue Owl Technology Income and Blue Owl Credit Income name a context 'Issuer, Instrument' with no separate instrument.

instrument_description_strip_re.description: Regex removed from this filer's instrument_description (a filer's own column headers or holder labels in the member text). Text it would empty is left as filed unless instrument_description_strip_may_empty is true.

instrument_description_strip_may_empty.description: When true, instrument_description_strip_re may leave the instrument blank: BCRED's 'Issuer | Emerald JV LP' puts only the joint venture's name after the separator (D-164).

shares_pow10_normalise.description: false keeps this filer's tagged unit counts as filed: the unified build's power-of-ten share normaliser (one group per issuer name, a count replaced when its unit price is over 1.5 orders of magnitude from the group median) is not applied. BCRED holds several share classes of one issuer at very different unit prices and blocker notes counted by par; the normaliser gave each another line's count (Point Broadband Class B printed 685,760, published 2,766). Evidence required: the replaced rows' tagged counts read against their printed lines.

heading_re.description: Regex matching the filer's top-level schedule headings (industry sub-headings must not match).

structured_re.description: Regex on those headings: rows printed under them are STRUCTURED_CREDIT.

equity_re.description: Regex on those headings: rows printed under them are also asset_category EQUITY_COMMON (CLO subordinated notes, units).

structured_credit_sections.description: Class by printed schedule section (pipeline/printed_sections.py), keyed by each row's fair-value contextRef. BCRED prints CLO tranches whose names lack 'CLO' (Octagon 55, CIFC Funding, Magnetite XXXII) under 'Structured Finance Obligations' and its subordinated notes under '- Equity Instruments'; the name classifier published 281 of them as direct lending and 223 equity tranches as loans. Evidence required: the section population read from the pages against the published class.

global_issuer_split.description: false opts this filer out of the shared issuer/instrument split (pipeline/issuer_instrument_split.py). Manulife Private Credit: its instrument text carries a per-quarter section heading, so instrument text moved there breaks position chains (cohort A/B 2026-10-14).

bare_entity_rows.description: The filer names a position by its company alone (Lord Abbett: 'Spark Buyer LLC' is the main term loan, 46.2M at 2025-03-31, beside 'Spark Buyer LLC Delayed Draw' and 'Spark Buyer LLC Revolver'). Without this, a filer with prefix_rules has every bare company name holding 'llc', 'group', 'limited' and the like dropped as an issuer subtotal. Evidence required: printed rows, and the quarter totals with the rows restored.

flat_schedule.description: When true, the schedule has no subtotal or category rows: a named identifier without a leaf marker is a position, not a category rollup

leaf_marker_re.description: Regex that marks an identifier as a position where no leaf keyword does (for example a row that ends with its maturity date)

category_marker_before_total.description: When true, category_marker_re demotes matching total-style rows to aggregate before total-rollup classification

staging.description: BDC staging SQL configuration for per-CIK extraction patterns

maturity_text_unspaced.description: The filer's member text writes the maturity without spaces ('($2,500par,due1/2030)'). When true, staging also reads a month-year maturity written 'par,due1/2030)' (pipeline/staging_bdc.py, _text_maturity_month_raw). Sixth Street Specialty Lending CLO members, 2023-03-31 to 2024-03-31: 14 to 26 loan rows a quarter published no maturity. Evidence required: the printed row's 'due M/YYYY' and the unspaced member. Every other filer keeps the spaced pattern.

hierarchy_prefix_re.description: Regex for hierarchy prefix to strip (prefix_strip strategy)

hierarchy_issuer_re.description: Regex to extract issuer from hierarchy (hierarchy_extract strategy)

hierarchy_instrument_re.description: Regex to extract instrument from hierarchy (hierarchy_extract strategy)

hierarchy_trailing_re.description: Regex for trailing tranche labels after maturity (hierarchy_extract strategy)

hierarchy_condition_extra.description: Additional SQL condition for hierarchy detection

type_industry_prefix_re.description: Regex for type/industry prefix to strip before leaf extraction

evidence_re.description: Regex for evidence fields (interest rate, maturity, etc.)

issuer_re.description: Regex to extract issuer from cleaned identifier

instrument_re.description: Regex to extract instrument from cleaned identifier

issuer_trailing_strip_re.description: Regex for text to drop from the end of the extracted issuer (Sixth Street from 2026-03-31: the column word 'Investment' sits between issuer and instrument in the label)

issuer_bridges.description: Manual issuer name bridges for specific identifiers (issuer_bridge strategy)

extra_industry_labels.description: Additional industry labels beyond the built-in set, used to expand the MSD_INDUSTRY_LABELS placeholder

distinct_member_suffix_re.description: Regex matched on the raw identifier; its match joins the duplicate-row key, so two positions with equal issuer, instrument and figures that differ only in this trailing member token are both kept

pipe_field_map.description: Declares which pipe-delimited segment indices hold the issuer name and instrument description for CIKs whose pipe format differs from the generic SLR pattern. Segment indices are 1-based (matching DuckDB array indexing).

issuer_segment.description: 1-based index of the pipe segment containing issuer name (possibly combined with instrument)

instrument_segments.description: 1-based indices of pipe segments to concatenate for instrument description

industry_segment.description: 1-based index of the pipe segment containing industry label

lien_segment.description: 1-based index of the pipe segment containing lien type / seniority

delimiter.description: Primary field delimiter in identifier strings

field_order.description: Expected order of fields in identifier strings

alternate_delimiters.description: Known alternate delimiters seen in some quarters

identifier_parser.description: Per-CIK identifier parsing configuration for structured field extraction

type.description: Parser type. hierarchical_pct: dash-separated segments with pct prefixes

issuer_boundary_keywords.description: Keywords that mark end of issuer name in leaf segment

industry_keyword.description: Keyword preceding industry name in leaf segment (e.g. Industry)

rate_shorthand.description: Map of rate shorthand prefix to reference rate type (e.g. S + -> SOFR)

country_list.description: Known country names for extraction from segment text

max_fv_pct.description: Maximum allowed unclassified share of fair value (read by wrapper_content_signatures; default 0.05)

b2_provenance.description: Audit trail written by pipeline/agent_b2_wrapper_patch.py: one entry per promoted wrapper fix, saying why the rule was added. Not read by the build.

segment_assertions.description: Canary assertions for pipe-delimited segment content. Used by I08 oracle check to detect format drift.

field_name.description: Human-readable field name for this segment (e.g. 'issuer', 'industry')

segment_count.description: Expected total number of pipe segments

min_prevalence.description: Minimum fraction of rows that should match this assertion

source_encodings.description: Source-backed filer encodings shared by staging and accounting scope.

cash_identifiers.description: Exact full identifiers that disclose cash positions; normalized whitespace and case only.

legal_entity_members.description: Explicit axis members that name a reporting entity, each as "axis=Member -> label" (for example "legalentityaxis=BCREDEmeraldJVLPMember -> Emerald JV LP"). A position context carrying that member after its identifier belongs to the labelled entity's own schedule.

filed_rate_reading.description: What this filer's plain interest rate tag (InvestmentInterestRate) holds: the all-in coupon with any PIK inside it, or the cash leg with PIK on top. Read by the finalizer only where the tag does not name its own kind. Evidence required: fully PIK loans whose filed rate equals the PIK rate (all-in), or filed rates below the PIK rate across the fund (cash leg). Under all_in a row whose PIK rate exceeds the filed rate stays unresolved.

rate_only_contexts.description: Set where the filer tags a loan's rate, spread or PIK on a context of its own, next to the context that carries the value. Staging joins the two when they are adjacent, share the first 16 letters and digits of the identifier and have no other candidate; the joined fields are named in src_filled_fields. Evidence required: printed schedule lines showing the rate on the value row.

pik_only_tag_reading.description: Set where a loan filed with a PIK rate tag, no plain rate tag and no spread carries its whole coupon in the PIK tag. The finalizer then publishes that rate as interest_rate (transform interest_rate:pik_only). Evidence required: printed schedule lines showing the PIK figure in the coupon column. Use margin where the PIK tag on such a row holds the margin over the reference rate: the finalizer then publishes it as basis_spread (transform basis_spread:pik_margin) on rows whose reference rate is known, and leaves pik_rate as filed. Evidence required for margin: printed lines of the form reference + margin PIK. Use coupon then margin where the filer has both kinds and names its reference-rate column (reference_rate_columns): a known reference rate makes the figure a margin, and it is the coupon only where that column prints N/A or nothing (coupon_type Fixed). Any other row stays as filed.

industry_columns.description: Printed header labels of the column in which this filer prints each row's industry (Oaktree Strategic Credit: 'Portfolio Company | Industry | Type of Investment ...', every row 'MRI Software LLC | Application Software | First Lien Term Loan ...'). The inline field-status reader then takes a row's industry from that cell and not from the last lone heading above it (which for such a layout is a section label). An empty cell gives no industry. Evidence required: the printed header and two printed rows.

reference_rate_columns.description: Printed header labels of the column that holds the reference-rate code on this filer's schedule (Blue Owl: Interest, then Ref. Rate from 2025-12-31). The inline field-status reader then treats that column as confirmed and reads no other column for the reference rate in that table. An empty cell or N/A in it, on a row naming no benchmark elsewhere, is recorded as not_applicable and sets a blank coupon_type to Fixed on a loan row that carries a rate. The value reaches holdings only where reference_rate_type is blank, and only after the field-status artifact is regenerated for the fund. Evidence required: printed lines showing the code in that column in each layout named.

reference_rate_codes.description: Codes this filer prints in its reference-rate column that the shared table does not know, as CODE=BENCHMARK (SR=SOFR). Take them from the filing's own legend. A code whose meaning changed is entered twice, once 'to' the last report date of the old meaning and once 'from' the first of the new (C=CDOR to 2024-03-31, C=CORRA from 2024-06-30); the loader refuses overlapping entries.

printed_margin_reading.description: Set where the filer prints the cash margin and the PIK margin in separate cells and tags the spread with the cash part only (Blue Owl from 2025-03-31; earlier filings print 'A% (B% PIK)' and tag the total A). Needs reference_rate_columns. On a loan row tagged with a spread and a PIK rate, where the printed total equals their sum and not the spread alone, the published basis_spread is the sum (transform basis_spread:cash_plus_pik_margin); pik_rate is unchanged. Evidence required: printed lines in both forms for one loan, with the tagged values.

unspecified_reference_labels.description: Labels this filer prints in its reference-rate column that name no single benchmark (Ares 'Base Rate': the legend says it is commonly based on the Federal Funds Rate or the Prime Rate). The row floats; a reference rate guessed from the report date is withdrawn and nothing else changes. Needs reference_rate_columns.

investments_total_excludes.description: Set where the filer's balance-sheet investments line leaves out the money market or short-term fund rows its schedule lists (Goldman Sachs: 'Investments, at fair value 9,630,944' and, on its own line, 'Investments in affiliated money market fund 233,261'). The fair-value conservation check then compares that line with the published rows that are not cash, and checks the cash rows against the filed cash-equivalents figure where one exists. The cash rows stay published. Evidence required: the balance-sheet lines, and published non-cash rows equal to the investments line in each quarter.

investments_total_includes_cash.description: Issuer-name patterns (regular expressions, case-insensitive) of cash-class rows the filer counts inside its printed 'Total Investments' (Overland: the U.S. Treasury Bill printed above 'Total Investments $ 1,626,749'). The rows stay classed as cash and out of the published fair value; the fund gate's totals comparison adds them to the non-cash rows. Owner ruling 2026-10-17 (D-202). Evidence required: the printed total line in each quarter.

cash_rows_include_concepts.description: Balance-sheet concept local names (us-gaap or the filer's own) whose filed instant values the schedule's cash rows also hold, beside the cash equivalents (Silver Point Specialty Lending, 10-Q 2023-09-30: 'Total Cash Equivalents and Restricted Cash Equivalents 92,114,292' = CashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue 49.9M + RestrictedCashEquivalents 42.2M). Read from the cached companyfacts and added, for the same date, to the filed cash-equivalents figure (fund_financials.cash_equivalents_at_fair_value) wherever a check anchors the cash rows on it: the conservation engine's cash anchor and cash status, and the GAV reconciliation (gav_reconciliation, F20, GAV_BDC02/03). Added only where a cash-equivalents figure is filed for the date. The published rows are unchanged. Evidence required: the printed cash total and the filed figures that sum to it.

subtotal_members.description: Regular expressions (RE2: no lookaround or back-references; matched case-insensitive against the whole source member as written) naming the filer's printed subtotal lines that no shared rule recognises (Silver Point Specialty Lending: 'Non-Controlled/Non-Affiliated Investments, Secured Loans, Total United States of America 1st Lien Term Loan' in 2023, and from 2024-06-30 'Non-Controlled/Non-Affiliated Investments United States of America Equities', with no word Total, for the printed 'Total United States of America Equities 474,538 2,349,171'). Source reconciliation marks such a source row with no published match as excluded_aggregate_candidate, not missing_from_pipeline, so E07, SRC_BDC01 and the source-only blockers stop counting it as a position. A matching row that IS published is untouched. Write each pattern for a whole member (anchored), never a bare word: an issuer whose name contains 'Total' must not match. Evidence required: one printed subtotal line per pattern whose value equals the member's tagged fair value.

cost_total_excludes.description: Needs investments_total_excludes cash_rows. The cost conservation check then compares the filed investments cost (InvestmentOwnedAtCost) with the published cost of the rows that are not cash, as the fair-value check does; the cash rows stay in value_sum and are anchored by the fair-value check only. Set where the filed cost total leaves the cash rows out like the fair-value total (Silver Point Specialty Lending, 10-Q 2023-06-30: 'Total Investments, June 30, 2023 $ 863,202,721 $ 847,380,975' with 'Total Cash Equivalents 84,630,043' printed below it). Evidence required: published non-cash cost equal to the filed cost in each quarter.

fair_value_concepts.description: Concept local names this filer uses for a position's fair value besides the shared ones (Golub: MoneyMarketFundsFairValueDisclosure on its money market rows, which otherwise carry a cost and no value and are dropped). Read for this filer only, by the extractor, source reconciliation and the re-verifier. Evidence required: the tag on a printed row.

context_identifiers.description: Position contexts a filing leaves without an identifier member, each as 'ACCESSION CONTEXT => IDENTIFIER', the identifier written as the filer writes it in its other filings (NexPoint Capital, 10-Qs for 2025-06-30 and 2025-09-30: ten of the printed rows sit on industry, affiliation and type members only). A context that already names a position is never renamed. Evidence required: the printed row whose fair-value tag uses the context.

units_tagged_as_par.description: Accession numbers of filings in which the filer tagged the unit count of its equity rows with the principal concept (Blue Owl Credit Income, 10-Q for 2023-09-30: 33 of 44 equity rows; the filings before and after use the share-count concept). In a listed filing an equity row with a principal tag and no share count publishes the tagged number as its unit count (transform shares_held:from_principal_tag). Evidence required: the concept counts of the filing against its neighbours, and a printed line whose unit count equals the tagged number.

pct_tagged_as_ratio.description: Accession numbers of filings in which the filer tags percent of net assets as a ratio above 0.50, which the shared row rule (multiply by 100 only up to 0.50) publishes unscaled (Ares Core Infrastructure Fund, 10-Q 2024-09-30: printed 224.22 %, tagged 2.2422). In a listed filing every tagged percent is multiplied by 100 (transform pct_of_net_assets:rate_x100). Evidence required: the printed percent and the tagged fact of a row, and fair value over net assets equal to the tagged ratio.

bracketed_unsigned_values.description: Accession numbers of filings in which the filer prints negative cost or fair value in brackets and tags it with no sign="-" (NMF SLF I, 10-K 2025-12-31 and the 10-Qs after it: 'DigiCert, Inc. Software First Lien(3)(4) - Undrawn - - - 07/2025 07/2030 512 ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 0.00 )%', tagged +3 and +4). In a listed filing each InvestmentOwnedAtCost and InvestmentOwnedAtFairValue fact whose printed sign differs from its tagged sign takes the printed sign (pipeline/printed_sign.py; event cik_scale_fix:x-1, which the re-verifier reads as a multiplier). Evidence required: printed lines in brackets and the unsigned tag on their contexts.

net_assets_concepts.description: Concept local names that hold this filer's total net assets, read by the calculated-percent denominator check (pipeline/financial_context.compatible_nav) INSTEAD of the shared list (StockholdersEquity, NetAssetsOrNetAssets, MembersCapital, PartnersCapital). For a filer that tags a paid-in line with a shared concept (TCW Direct Lending VIII: 'Common Unitholders capital 879,986' as MembersCapital, 'Total Members Capital 815,597' as MembersEquity). The published net assets still come from the fund financials (for TCW VIII the printed figures of its highlights wrapper); this only names the cached fact they must equal. Evidence required: the printed balance-sheet lines and the concept of each.

whole_dollar_scale_filings.description: Accession numbers of filings whose schedule is printed in whole dollars while part of the investment facts carry scale 3 / decimals -3, so the instance holds them 1,000 times too large (TCW Direct Lending VIII, 10-Q 2023-03-31: HOP Energy 'Term Loan ... 22,548,887 06/17/27 22,130,144 21,218,503', principal and fair value tagged decimals 0, cost tagged decimals -3 as 22,130,144,000; cost 43 facts at -3 and 33 at 0, so the shared mixed-decimals guard, which needs 75 pct of one kind, does not fire and the quarter-level 1000x guard then divides every fact). In a listed filing every investment-context cost, fair value and principal fact tagged decimals -3 or coarser is read at decimals 0 (pipeline/bdc_filings._normalize_mixed_decimals_monetary_facts; event decimals_rescale:10^-3, which the re-verifier reads as a multiplier), in the extractor and in source reconciliation alike. Evidence required: printed lines in whole dollars and the decimals of their tags.

printed_rows_without_context.description: Owner ruling 2026-10-18 (OVR-T8Y-R2, option a): schedule rows a filing prints and does not tag at all (no fact, no context for the quarter), published from the printed line (TCW Direct Lending VIII, 10-Q 2023-09-30: Harvey Gulf Term Loans A and B and the Lenox Term Loan, 92.4M, have only 2022-12-31 comparative contexts). Each entry gives the accession, the quarter, the issuer and instrument as printed, the printed fair value, cost and principal (whole dollars), the verbatim printed line and optionally the printed industry heading; the loader refuses an entry whose line does not contain its issuer, instrument and three numbers as printed. Optionally (OVR-T8Z-R2, 2026-10-18, D-208) the printed interest rate, spread, floor and percent of net assets (as printed: 12.63 for '12.63%'), reference rate code and maturity (YYYY-MM-DD, printed MM/DD/YY); each must be printed in the line or the loader refuses the entry. The extractor adds one record per entry with context printed_page:<hash> and nothing it was not given (nothing is parsed from the line); staging labels fair value, cost and principal printed_page in the *_source columns, so no check reads them as XBRL facts. A listed row the filing does tag on a current-period context (its issuer and instrument, or its fair value and cost) is refused and logged, not duplicated (pipeline/printed_rows.py). Evidence required: the printed line, and a scan of the filing's contexts showing none for the row.

section_total_reading.description: Opt-in: the filer prints a schedule section's own total as '<section> Total' (APS BDC, 10-Q 2026-03-31: 'First Lien Debt Total $ 1,652,462,304 $ 1,641,801,287 115.91 %') rather than 'Total <section>'. The page reader then closes the section at that row and takes its tagged fair value as the section's printed total for the lien reconciliation gate. Without it the section stays open and a later 'Total First Lien Debt' line of a notes table (the Level 3 inputs table, 1,290,025,881) is taken as the section total. Evidence required: the printed section total line and its tagged fair value.

par_tagged_as_units.description: 'rows_within_twice_cost': as rows_near_cost with a band of 0.5 to 2 times cost, for a fund whose rows are notes bought at a discount (evidence: printed par lines). In both row modes a count filed unscaled is multiplied by the one power of a thousand that puts it in the band. 'rows_near_cost': single rows of any filing tag their par as a share count (CLO subordinated notes, asset-backed securities); the count is taken as the par only where it lies within 0.8 to 1.25 times the row's cost, so a count at another scale or in another currency stays a finding. Or accession numbers of filings in which the filer tagged the par amount of its loans with the share-count concept (InvestmentOwnedBalanceShares) instead of the principal concept (HPS Corporate Lending, 10-Q for 2026-03-31: 696 of 835 position contexts; the filings before and after use the principal concept on about 95 pct). In a listed filing a row classed as a loan that carries a count and no principal publishes the count as its principal (transform principal_amount:from_shares_tag). Evidence required: the concept counts of the filing against its neighbours, and a printed line whose par equals the tagged count.

rate_tag_reading.description: cash_rate_with_plain_spread (Stepstone, D-112): the paid-in-cash tag is the rate and a plain tag beside it with no spread tag is the spread. coupon_with_margins: The filer tags a loan's total coupon in InvestmentInterestRate and its cash and PIK margins in InvestmentInterestRatePaidInCash and InvestmentInterestRatePaidInKind (BlackRock Private Credit Fund: 'IQN Holding ... 2.63 % Cash + 3.13 % PIK 9.45 %' tags 0.0263, 0.0313 and 0.0945). The plain tag is then the rate and the paid-in-cash tag the cash margin (basis_spread where no spread is tagged); a context with no plain tag is read as before. Evidence required: printed lines beside the three tagged facts of their contexts.

untagged_pik.description: A rate tagged as the cash rate with no PIK tag on the context is the whole coupon (the filer's column is 'Cash Interest Rate / PIK Rate' and a PIK row prints both). Stepstone, D-112.

schedule_row_tags.description: The filer reuses its schedule members in other notes (an affiliate roll-forward with fair value only; joint-venture or facility amounts rounded to the hundred thousand), so those contexts read as positions (Barings Private Credit, 10-Q for 2023-06-30: seven roll-forward contexts, 203.2M, beside their schedule rows). With this setting a context is a position only if it carries a cost tag or a percent-of-net-assets tag and none of its value facts has decimals below -3 (cost_or_percent_unrounded); cost_or_percent drops the rounding clause, for a filer that tags some schedule fair values at decimals -4 and whose note rows carry neither cost nor percent (T Series 10-K for 2024-12-31, c-277, Fetch Insurance 1,690 at decimals -4). Evidence required: a note context beside its schedule row, and the quarter totals with the test applied.

unfunded_rows.description: The filer lists each undrawn commitment in its schedule as a row at the committed amount and subtracts the commitments again as one line per section (KKR FS Income Trust, 10-Q for 2026-03-31: 'Sotheby's, Revolver (i) 31,849 31,849 31,849', footnote (i) 'Security is an unfunded commitment', then 'Unfunded Loan Commitments (430,150) (430,150)'). Each such row is published net: cost and fair value less the commitment the filing tags for it in its commitments note; the principal keeps the committed amount. A row is netted only when its name starts with the commitment's name and its cost equals the tagged amount. Evidence required: the printed offset line and a commitment-note fact beside its schedule row.

cost_in_two_units.description: The filer tags the par of a foreign loan with the cost concept and the foreign unit, beside the dollar cost, and tags no principal (Apollo Debt Solutions, 10-K for 2025-12-31, JOA Joker Holdco 3: printed 'EUR 126,725 132,847 147,810'; tagged InvestmentOwnedAtCost 126,725,000 in EUR and 132,847,000 in USD). A context with exactly two cost facts, one in a unit the filing defines as USD and one in another currency, publishes the dollar fact as its cost and the foreign fact as its principal in that currency (transforms cost:of_two_units, principal_amount:from_foreign_cost_tag). Evidence required: printed lines beside the two cost facts of their contexts.

untagged_values.description: Values a printed row shows and its tags lack, each as 'ACCESSION CONTEXT FIELD VALUE' in dollars (Sixth Street 0000950170-25-021144: the Elysium BidCo preference shares print a fair value of 49,063 and tag only the cost). Only a missing value is filled; a tagged value is never replaced. Evidence required: the printed row and the context's tagged facts.

misdated_contexts.description: Contexts the filer dated to the wrong period, each as 'ACCESSION CONTEXT FILED-DATE -> CORRECT-DATE' (Ares Strategic Income 0001918712-25-000030 c-285: the 2025-03-31 Grant Thornton loan tagged on a context dated 2024-12-31). The parser re-dates the context, so the row keeps every tagged fact. Evidence required: the printed row in the schedule of the correct date, the context's filed date, and the gap to the printed total it closes.

page_labelled_contexts.description: Axis combinations (lower-case local names joined by '+') of contexts on which this filer tags a schedule row that is the only position in its group, with no investment-identifier member (Golub 10-Qs from 2023-12-31). A context with exactly that axis set is read as a position when exactly one printed row carries its fair-value tag and the row starts with a label, not an amount and not 'Total'; its identifier is the row's first two text cells joined by ' | '. Subtotal rows print amounts only and are never adopted. Evidence required: the printed row, its context's members, and the gap between the tagged rows and the printed total it closes.

equity_instrument_labels.description: Instrument descriptions this filer prints in its equity section that no shared keyword recognises (Blue Owl: 'LLC interest', 'Investment partnership'). Matched against the whole description, case and spacing aside, and consulted after every keyword and before the financial-field heuristic, which otherwise reads a tagged unit count as a loan principal. Take each label from the printed schedule.

foreign_unit_values.description: Opt-in: this filer states schedule fair value and cost in US dollars even where the fact carries a foreign-currency unit tag (the tag follows the loan's currency). Such values are kept as filed and not converted. Evidence required: the untouched values sum to the filed total, and fair value over local principal sits at the exchange rate rather than at 1.

principal_usd_reference.description: Opt-in: principal reported in a foreign currency is converted to USD with the admitted Federal Reserve H.10 quotes (report date, or the latest quote within seven days before it). The result is a reference conversion, not a filed value.

detached_schedule_labels.description: Opt-in: position contexts that follow a large jump in context order within a filing and period are a second schedule in the notes (for example a joint venture's own portfolio). Staging appends this label to their dimensions as a reporting-entity segment, so they are retained as underlying_schedule rows and left out of the published basis.

reporting_entity_suffixes.description: Exact bare pipe segments naming a reporting portfolio after the investment identifier.

reporting_entity_identifier_suffixes.description: Exact portfolio labels at the end of InvestmentIdentifierAxis, after a legal borrower suffix and optional ordinal/comma; a trailing position ordinal is allowed and retained in the raw identifier.
